name: run_query
description: Run an aggregation pipeline against the source data with the page's sample parameters (the selected client, and asOfDate) and return up to 20 result rows with the full row count. Call it to test every pipeline before submitting, and to check intermediate assumptions (e.g. totals before and after a $lookup). Errors come back with the database's reason - fix the pipeline and run it again.

collection.description: A data collection of the bank database (see the data dictionary), e.g. holdings.

pipeline.description: MongoDB aggregation stages, read-only. Reference parameters as {"$param": "clientId"} / {"$param": "asOfDate"}; never literal client ids or dates.

params.description: The parameters the pipeline references as {"$param": "name"}. Declare asOfDate (type date) whenever the pipeline uses it.

name.description: clientId or asOfDate (or another page parameter)
